name: Ogg

source.verification: Official Xiph.Org release tarball, downloaded on 2026-11-23; its SHA-256 matches downloads.xiph.org/releases/ogg/SHA256SUMS. Imported files are the two library sources, their headers and COPYING (build files, documentation and the generated config_types.h template are not imported).

notes: Ogg container library for the Vorbis and Opus source decoders of the audio importer (Docs/Design/AudioSystem.ko.md section 3.28). Developer only: AudioTools links it, runtime targets do not.

os_types.h defines the integer types itself on Windows (MSVC and clang-cl) and macOS; on Linux and Android it includes ogg/config_types.h, which is an added file here (the configure output for stdint.h — modifications).

modifications.reason: Added file: the configure-generated integer type header (upstream include/ogg/config_types.h.in with the stdint.h choices), which os_types.h includes on platforms other than Windows and Apple. Without it the Linux and Android builds fail (ogg/config_types.h not found).
